hero.description: docs/design-decisions.md decision A — individually-modeled hero buildings, 8-12 per era at full content scale (Phase 5); this Phase 1 skeleton only carries the flag.

wonder.description: docs/content-design.md §4 — The Great Lighthouse ending. At most one building across all content may set this true (ContentLinter.CheckWonderUniqueness). Global completion is exclusive; a losing civ's investment is refunded (ConstructionEngine.ProcessTurn).

foodBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — additive Food viability bonus at the settlement's own tile on completion, via ModifierLayer (Garrison's pattern). Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.

productionBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — settlement-scoped percent multiplier on the settlement's own Production ledger output (EconomyEngine.ProcessTurn), not via ModifierLayer (no Production viability channel exists). Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.

tradeBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — additive Trade viability bonus at the settlement's own tile on completion, via ModifierLayer. Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.

safetyBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — additive Safety viability bonus at the settlement's own tile on completion, via ModifierLayer. Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.

goldBonusPercent.description: Plan v3 task 4.5 — settlement-scoped percent multiplier on the settlement's own Gold ledger output (EconomyEngine.ProcessTurn), not via ModifierLayer (no Gold viability channel exists), same pattern as productionBonusPercent. Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.
